inputs.text: Health workers in Nigeria are courageously standing up for their labor rights against these controversial reform bills that will only deepen systemic inequality in healthcare. On Thursday, members of the Joint Health Sector Unions and the Assembly of Healthcare Professional Associations marched through Abuja protesting the legislation at the National Assembly. They assembled at the Unity Fountain in Maitama to challenge the changes that would weaken labor protections and move priorities away from the needs of ordinary people. This effort by those in power is intended to entrench institutional interests over the vulnerable, extending historical divides that have restricted access to care for marginalized communities. As a result, frontline staff and the patients they serve are left more exposed to exploitation and neglect. We must focus on protecting workers and advancing structural reforms rooted in social justice instead of these top-down changes that benefit the powerful at the expense of everyone else.
